objective: The bug button docks in every screen header, never floats, and Close is always the last control on the right.
userOutcome: Every screen shows the bug button in its own header row beside the other header controls, on a phone and on desktop.
successCriteria: Every component with a header row registers a bug-button slot at the right end of the row, before Close where the row has one.
No header reserves an empty corner for a floating button.
Header titles stay on one line; a long title truncates.
Renders at 412px of Settings, Feed, Rewards, Ghost Mode, Edit Profile and the profile panel show the button docked, on top, right-aligned.
The map's top action capsule hugs its five icons at every width; no stretch, no empty ends.
mustPreserve: Every header's existing controls and their order, apart from the added slot.
Screens that already docked the button.
nonGoals: No other visual change to any header.

assumptions.statement: The Sep 4 rule (every header one line, bug button in that row, screens register a slot) and "a designer wouldnt float shit randomly" authorize docking on every header in one pass.
assumptions.impact: One slot added to 36 headers; the global corner reservation removed.
